prompt: Documentary still life photograph in a bright, quiet print room, cool daylight, shallow depth of field, calm and precise editorial look, but vivid: saturated process inks (cyan, magenta, yellow) and coloured paper stocks against paper white and slate blue. A stack of translucent layout sheets on a light table, each sheet tinted a different process colour (cyan, magenta, yellow), ruled into different columns and rows and slightly offset, so where the column grids overlap the colours mix into deep blue, red and green; one region on the top sheet outlined with a thin vermilion line. Absolutely no legible text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no trademarks.
